hero.subtitle: Connect once and publish to every major platform. Markaestro handles the API differences, character limits, and media requirements so you can focus on the message.

stats.label: Social Channels
stats.sub: Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, Pinterest, X

channels.name: Facebook
channels.description: Reach billions on the world's largest social network. Publish to Pages and manage feed posts with full creative control.
capabilities: Page feed posts with rich media
Carousel and multi-image posts up to 10 items

channels.name: Instagram
channels.description: Publish to Instagram professional accounts directly from Markaestro. Feed posts, carousels, Reels, and Stories over the official API.
capabilities: Single image and video feed posts
Stories with a single image or video
Instagram Login for standalone professional accounts

channels.name: TikTok
channels.description: Reach Gen Z and beyond on the fastest-growing short-form platform. By default Markaestro hands photos and videos to the creator's TikTok inbox to finish and post; Direct Post to the profile is available per post.
capabilities: Inbox handoff by default, Direct Post per post

channels.name: LinkedIn
channels.description: Publish to your own LinkedIn profile or to a Page you manage. Text, image, video, and organic multi-image posts go out over LinkedIn's official API.
capabilities: Single image or single video posts
Target a Profile or a managed Page

channels.name: Threads
channels.description: Meta's text-first network. Markaestro creates the media container, waits for it to finish processing, then publishes, so slow video uploads never silently fail.
capabilities: Single image or single video posts

channels.name: Pinterest
channels.description: Pin your images and video to a board you choose when you connect. Your caption becomes the pin description, and everything publishes over the official Pinterest API.
capabilities: Image pins and carousels up to 5 images
Video pins with upload status polling

channels.name: X
channels.description: Post to X from the same composer as every other channel. Text, images, GIFs, and video go out over the official X API, with reply controls per post and live metrics pulled back into Analytics.
capabilities: Up to four images, one GIF, or one video
Live post metrics and account audience
Workspace spend protection for the X API

steps.title: Connect
steps.desc: Click 'Connect' on any channel. Authorize via OAuth. Markaestro securely stores and auto-refreshes your tokens.

steps.title: Create
steps.desc: Write your content in the unified composer. Preview how it looks on each platform before publishing.

steps.title: Publish
steps.desc: Hit publish or schedule for later. Markaestro handles formatting, media specs, and API calls for every channel.

cta.title: Connect Your First Channel in Under Two Minutes
cta.subtitle: Click, authorize, and start publishing, no developer setup required. Once a channel is connected, your team publishes from the dashboard and your AI agent can publish to the same channel through the API.
